原文: WW II½ is a hypothetical conflcit between the Western Allies and the USSR in the immediate aftermath of WWII in Europe.
含占位符: WW II½ is a hypothetical conflcit between the Western Allies and the USSR in the immediate aftermath of WWII in Europe.

原文: It uses one of the features of PeG that hasn't yet been exploited in a campaign.
含占位符: It uses one of the features of PeG that hasn't yet been exploited in a campaign.

原文: Victory conditions are based on the number of VH's you capture from the AI's control.
含占位符: Victory conditions are based on the number of VH's you capture from the AI's control.

原文: If you look at the prompt between turns (or if you hit the F1 key) you will be told how many hexes you must capture for any given victory level.
含占位符: If you look at the prompt between turns (or if you hit the F1 key) you will be told how many hexes you must capture for any given victory level.

原文: If at any time you capture the number of hexes necessary for a BV, or if you destroy all of the AI's units, you will get a Brilliant Victory.  Otherwise, your victory level is determined based on the number of hexes you have captured by the last turn.
含占位符: If at any time you capture the number of hexes necessary for a BV, or if you destroy all of the AI's units, you will get a Brilliant Victory.  Otherwise, your victory level is determined based on the number of hexes you have captured by the last turn.

原文: It should be noted that one cannot achive a BV in the first scenario.  The number of hexes reqired for a BV is greater than what is on the map.  This will force you to defend against the Ai for the duration of the scenario.  The prestige awards are adjusted accordingly.

原文: There are three invasion scenarios (Sakhalin, Vlaivostok, and Irkutsk).  In each of these, there are "amphibious invasion ships".  These units have the combat support function and so will act as mobile deployment hexes.
